current.label: 2026 Tricycle Fare Matrix Ordinance of Cabanatuan City
current.effectiveDate: TODO: 15 days after newspaper publication (Sec. 15); publication not found. Stickers launch 2026-10-19.
current.partKmRule: Each succeeding 0.01 to 1.00 km is charged as a full km (Sec. 3, Sec. 4.1).
current.specialTrip: Allowed only when the passenger requests it: one passenger hires the whole tricycle so it leaves the City Supermarket TODA terminal without waiting, and pays two passenger fares (Sec. 2d). The ordinance does not say whether this applies to street pick-ups.
current.fuelPriceAdjustment: The rates above are the base band for gasoline at PHP 50.00-59.99/L. For every PHP 10/L rise the Tricycle Franchising and Regulatory Board may set a provisional rate of +PHP 2.50 base and +PHP 0.50 per km, for up to 60 days (Sec. 5). The bands below copy the Sec. 5 table; a band applies only once the board activates it. Discounted per-km rates are 80% rounded to the nearest PHP 0.50, so they are not exactly 80%. The city's poster prints band ranges as e.g. PHP 50.00-59.00; the certified copy reads 50.00-59.99.
current.penaltiesNote: Sec. 8: the first two offenses are a fine OR impoundment of the unit, not both. The third cancels and revokes the operator's MTOP.
current.barangayTable: Not modelled. Sec. 4 also lists fixed fares from the City Supermarket TODA terminal to 89 barangays; above about 6.5 km they are lower than the per-km formula.

history.summary: P14 regular fare for the first 1 to 3 km

Matrix last adjusted November 2018 (stickers issued 2019), in force until Ordinance No. 050-2026. First 3 km: P20 solo / P15 each for 2 or more; discounted P15 / P10; +P5 per passenger per km after 3 km. Ordinance number not found; figures from a 2025 study.
